digest.component_or_area: store lock management and compaction sweep
propositions: A blocked writer cannot identify whether a lock holder is a compaction sweep or determine if it is safe to interrupt, receiving only a bare pid in the timeout error

The compaction sweep code path already guarantees that a skipped sweep is a no-op (events stay live, next trigger re-folds), making it safely interruptible, but this guarantee is not communicated to operators
Lock holder information must be enriched with an operation label that reaches the lock stamp via an ambient contextvars mechanism without modifying the per-ticket acquisition call in compact_txn.py
The lock timeout error message must state when a holder is a known interruptible operation (compact-sweep) and explain the safe remedy to the operator
